newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU draft jobs chapter shows no real incentives.
newsitem.headline: EU draft jobs chapter shows no real incentives.

text.p: A draft version of the European Union's revised treaty offers little in the way of substantive initiatives to lower the 15-nation bloc's high level of joblessness.

Early copies of the treaty's employment chapter, designed to show the EU's commitment to tackle unemployment, says the bloc "may adopt incentive measures designed to encourage cooperation between member states."
Among the initiatives mentioned, the draft notes that there could be "exchanges of information" between EU governments as well as "comparative analysis" and "advice".
All of this would be designed to promote innovative approaches and to evaluate experiences governments have in creating jobs.
Nowhere in the text is there any mention of shifting EU funds towards large employment programmes.
EU leaders will meet in Amsterdam on June 16 and 17 to discuss revisions to the Maastricht Treaty.
